plan.goal: Evaluate the UX of the WeaveAPI developer documentation, focusing on the clarity of the primary 'Charges' flow, the usability of the interactive 'Try-it' panel, and mobile responsiveness.
plan.summary: The run will proceed from the Index home page through the Quickstart guide to the core Charges API reference. It will heavily exercise the interactive 'Try-it' panel on the Charges page to validate mock response logic (success vs. error states). Finally, it will cover adjacent resources (Customers, Webhooks, Errors) and repeat critical navigation checks on a mobile viewport to address known tap-target risks.
assumptions: The 'Try-it' panel on charges.html is functional and returns mock JSON responses based on input parameters as described in the prescan.
Code block tabs (CURL, PYTHON, NODE, GO) switch content dynamically without page reloads.
The site uses local file paths, so cross-page navigation relies on relative links.
risk_hotspots: charges.html: Interactive 'Try-it' panel parameter validation and response rendering.
Global Navigation: Left sidebar links are <44px height (31px), posing mobile usability risks.
Code Blocks: Tab switching mechanism and 'Copy' button affordance.
Mobile Viewport: Horizontal overflow risks on wide code snippets or parameter tables.

phases.title: Onboarding & Home Page Structure
phases.objective: Validate the entry point, global navigation consistency, and initial information architecture.
key_checks: Verify left sidebar navigation groups (Getting Started, Core Resources, etc.) are visible and clickable.
Test 'Search docs' input field focus state.
Click 'Quickstart' card/link to verify transition to quickstart.html.
Check dark mode toggle (moon icon) functionality if present/visible.
exit_criteria: Successfully navigated from index.html to quickstart.html.
Confirmed sidebar persistence across the transition.

phases.title: Quickstart Flow Validation
phases.objective: Ensure the '5-minute' setup guide is clear and code examples are accessible.
key_checks: Verify step-by-step layout (Install SDK -> First Charge).
Interact with code block language tabs (CURL, PYTHON, NODE, GO) to ensure content updates.
Click 'Copy' button on a code block to check for visual feedback (tooltip/text change).
Follow 'Read on: full Charges reference' link to charges.html.
exit_criteria: Navigated to charges.html via the contextual link.

phases.title: Core Resource: Charges API & Interactive Panel
phases.objective: Deep dive into the most complex page, validating the 'Try-it' playground and endpoint documentation.
key_checks: Scroll to verify right-column 'Try-it' panel syncs with the active endpoint section (Create, Retrieve, etc.).
Interaction A: Submit valid params (currency=usd) in 'Create a charge' panel; expect success JSON.
Interaction B: Submit invalid param (currency=xyz); expect 'currency_not_supported' error JSON.
Verify parameter tables are readable and aligned with the code examples.
Check anchor links in the right-hand 'On this page' TOC scroll to correct sections.
exit_criteria: Mock API responses received for both success and error cases.

phases.title: Adjacent Resources & Error Handling
phases.objective: Explore secondary pages to ensure consistent layout and discoverability of error states.
key_checks: Navigate to Customers: Verify object attribute table readability.
Navigate to Webhooks: Check event type list and signature verification instructions.
Navigate to Errors: Validate the table of error codes (e.g., card_declined, insufficient_funds) is scannable.
Test breadcrumb or sidebar back-navigation from these deep pages to Index.
exit_criteria: No broken links encountered in sidebar or body content.

phases.title: Mobile Responsiveness & Accessibility
phases.objective: Re-evaluate critical flows on mobile viewport to address known small tap-target risks.
key_checks: Switch to mobile viewport (e.g., iPhone SE/12).
Verify sidebar collapses into a hamburger menu or drawer.
Attempt to tap sidebar links (known 31px height risk) to assess miss-rate/difficulty.
Check for horizontal scrolling issues on code blocks and parameter tables.
Verify 'Try-it' panel on charges.html is usable or gracefully degrades on mobile.
exit_criteria: Mobile navigation is functional despite small tap targets.
Content reflows without breaking layout (no unscrollable overflow).

coverage_targets.pages: 100% of listed HTML files (index, quickstart, charges, customers, webhooks, errors)
coverage_targets.features: All code block tabs, Copy buttons, Try-it panel inputs (valid/invalid), Sidebar navigation, Dark mode toggle
coverage_targets.mobile: Full navigation flow + Charges interaction on mobile viewport

notes: Prioritize the 'Try-it' panel on charges.html as it is the highest value interactive element.
Document specific instances where the 31px sidebar links cause mis-clicks on mobile.
If the 'Try-it' panel is hidden on mobile, note this as a significant UX gap for developers on tablets/phones.

prescan_summary.title: WeaveAPI — Threads of value, woven simple
prescan_summary.visible_text_excerpt: WeaveAPI GETTING STARTED Quickstart Authentication Idempotency Pagination CORE RESOURCES Charges Customers PAYMENT METHODS Cards Bank Wallets WEBHOOKS Events Verifying Retries ERRORS Error codes 🌙 Accept your first payment in 5 minutes. WeaveAPI is a payments-as-an-API platform built for backend engineers who want to ship value capture without inheriting a banking compliance department. Quickstart The most basic flow: collect a payment method, create a charge, capture funds. CURL PYTHON NODE GO curl -X POST https://api.weave.dev/v1/charges \ -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_test_4eC39HqLyjWDarjtT1zdp7dc" \ -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \ -d amount=2000 -d currency=usd -d payment_method=pm_card_visa Copy Authentication WeaveAPI uses API keys. Test keys are prefixed sk_test_; live keys are sk_live_. Send your key in the Authorization header as a bearer token. CURL PYTHON NODE GO curl https:

prescan_summary.title: Errors — WeaveAPI
prescan_summary.visible_text_excerpt: WeaveAPI GETTING STARTED Quickstart Authentication Idempotency Pagination CORE RESOURCES Charges Customers PAYMENT METHODS Cards Bank Wallets WEBHOOKS Events Verifying Retries ERRORS Error codes 🌙 Error codes All WeaveAPI errors are returned as a structured object. Use code for programmatic handling and message for display. CODE HTTP MESSAGE HOW TO HANDLE card_declined 402 The card was declined Surface a retry; offer alternate payment method insufficient_funds 402 Insufficient funds on the card Retry with a different method expired_card 402 The card has expired Prompt user to update the card incorrect_cvc 402 CVC check failed Re-ask for the CVC processing_error 502 Issuer was unreachable Safe to retry with idempotency key fraud_blocked 402 Blocked by our risk system Do not retry; escalate via dashboard three_d_secure_required 402 3DS authentication required Redirect to three_d_secure.url

prescan_summary.title: Webhooks — WeaveAPI
prescan_summary.visible_text_excerpt: WeaveAPI GETTING STARTED Quickstart Authentication Idempotency Pagination CORE RESOURCES Charges Customers PAYMENT METHODS Cards Bank Wallets WEBHOOKS Events Verifying Retries ERRORS Error codes 🌙 Webhooks WeaveAPI sends HTTP POST callbacks to your endpoint when interesting events happen. Each event is signed; verify before processing. Event types EVENT DESCRIPTION charge.succeeded A charge transitioned to succeeded charge.failed A charge transitioned to failed charge.refunded Full or partial refund applied charge.disputed Buyer opened a dispute charge.dispute.closed Dispute resolved (won or lost) customer.created New customer record customer.updated Customer attributes changed customer.deleted Customer was deleted payment_method.attached PM linked to a customer payment_method.detached PM unlinked invoice.created New invoice generated invoice.finalized Invoice is no longer draft invoice.
